subject: Calendar mix-up and delivery hold
text: I totally read the calendar entry wrong, and I am now sitting here wondering how a simple delivery turned into a small mystery. I thought your building entrance was listed as the loading dock, but after a closer look it was the café side, and the note about 'afternoon only' meant today, not 'afternoon of the following week.' Anyway, the delivery person was nice enough to hold the package at the front desk, but they left a card with a time stamp I cannot quite decode. Could you check the calendar invite from yesterday and tell me which room or area you originally meant? I do not want to go to the wrong door again and have the parcel sitting under someone's desk for three days. Also, if you are going to be in the hallway near the mail room this afternoon, maybe you could grab it while I am in the budget meeting? I have the delivery receipt attached, though I am not sure if the last four digits are even the right unit number. Sorry to make this louder than it needs to be. It is one of those tiny things that spirals if nobody looks at it early. If the invite needs to be edited, I can re-do it after you confirm the spot. Just do not let the box live near the printer again.
